The Arcade Google Calendar MCP Server uses the [Google auth provider](/references/auth-providers/google) to connect to users' Google accounts.
---

## UpdateGoogleMeetOptions

- **`NONE`**: No action is taken.
- **`ADD`**: Add the Google Meet link to the event.
- **`REMOVE`**: Remove the Google Meet link from the event.
